basic_details.job_title: Odisha Research Centre Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 45 Senior & Junior Research Internship Programme Posts
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Research Centre has invited online applications for 45 vacancies, including Senior Research Internship and Junior Research Internship posts. Applications can be submitted at odisharesearchcentre.org till 15 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at odisharesearchcentre.org or access the direct internship program page.
Click on the online application link provided for the internship programme through the Google Form.
Fill in the required candidate and educational details accurately within the application form.
Submit the completed online application form before the deadline of 15/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Research Centre Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Odisha Research Centre (in collaboration with TISS, Mumbai)
Senior Research Internship: 6 Months; Junior Research Internship: 3 Months
Senior Research Internship, Junior Research Internship
Senior Research Internship: ₹ 25,000 per month; Junior Research Internship: ₹ 15,000 per month
Bhubaneswar, Odisha (IIT Kharagpur Extension Campus, Samantapuri)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Odisha Research Centre Recruitment 2026 offers a total of 45 internship positions across two distinct designations.

rows.essential_qualification: Master’s Degree (≥55%) in Social Sciences, Humanities or allied disciplines
Bachelor’s Degree (≥55%) in Social Sciences, Humanities or allied disciplines

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected interns will receive a consolidated monthly stipend of ₹ 25,000 for the Senior Research Internship (6 months duration) and ₹ 15,000 for the Junior Research Internship (3 months duration). The notification does not specify additional allowances, HRA, or extension terms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Odisha Research Centre Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at odisharesearchcentre.org or access the direct internship program page. Click on the online application link provided for the internship programme through the Google Form. Fill in the required candidate and educational details accurately within the application form. Submit the completed online application form before the deadline of 15/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe the specific selection stages, shortlisting criteria, or interview dates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for Odisha Research Centre Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Internship?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks in Social Sciences, Humanities, or allied disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. Are age relaxations or upper age limits specified in the notification?
faq.answer: Age limits and relaxations are not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is the internship position permanent or on contract, and what is the duration?
faq.answer: The notification specifies fixed internship durations of 6 months for Senior Research Internships and 3 months for Junior Research Internships, but does not state whether positions are permanent or contractual beyond the internship period.
